title.narrative: Enhancing Professional Development of Teachers through Education for Sustainable Development (ESD) Training in Pakistan

description.narrative: This workplan aims to enhance teacher professional development in Pakistan through customized training in Education for Sustainable Development (ESD), aligning with UNESCO’s 42 C/5 Output by improving education quality and fostering critical thinking and innovation among students. Key activities include developing and delivering ESD training modules, providing hands-on workshops, and establishing mentorship programs. Deliverables target training 40-50 teachers, integrating ESD concepts into teaching practices within six months, and improving student performance in ESD subjects by 20% within one year. Baselines will assess current STEM competencies, with goals set for enhancing these skills. Context analysis highlights the need for ESD training, with UNESCO leveraging its expertise and partnerships for effective implementation. Beneficiaries include teachers and students, with key partners such as training institutions, education departments, and NGOs. The project contributes to SDGs 4 and 9, aiming for long-term impacts like a skilled workforce and enhanced economic development. Activities will be monitored and adjusted to ensure effectiveness, with strategies to address risks and promote sustainability.
